newsitem.title: USA: Cytogen says clearances slowed Quadramet revs.
newsitem.headline: Cytogen says clearances slowed Quadramet revs.

text.p: Cytogen Corp said Friday it does not expect to generate "meaningful" revenues from its new drug Quadramet until the third quarter.

The company said even though Quadrament received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance in March, such radiopharmaceutical therapies require additional levels of regulatory clearance on the part of the manufacturer, the clinical treatment facility and the physician who administers the treatment.

"From a practical point of view, this means that product sales of Quadramet could not be initiated at such facilities until the four to eight week process of user license amendment was completed," Cytogen chairman, president and chief executive officer Thomas McKearn said in a letter to stockholders.
